full.description: This image shows a light micrograph of a duodenal biopsy from a patient. The histological section demonstrates clusters of vacuolated enterocytes, particularly located at the tips of the intestinal villi. These intracellular lipid vacuoles accumulate due to abetalipoproteinemia (ABL), which prevents proper chylomicron assembly and fat absorption. The findings are characteristic of abetalipoproteinemia.

random.description: This is a micrograph showing a histological section of respiratory-type epithelium. The left panel demonstrates normal ciliated columnar cells with goblet cells, while the right panel shows epithelial changes, such as squamous metaplasia and dysplasia. These findings are consistent with chronic airway irritation or inflammation commonly seen in conditions like chronic bronchitis or precancerous changes. The images highlight the structural transformation of the respiratory mucosa under pathological stimuli.
